title: British Beef Stew à la Française
description: A hearty French-inspired beef stew with a rich and savory flavor, made with tender British beef and a hint of umami.

ingredients.name: British Beef (1.5 pounds), cut into 2-inch cubes

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the onion and carrot until they are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.
Enjoy your hearty and flavorful British Beef Stew à la Française!
